title: AceSupply
description: Add supply drops to your minecraft server.
body:
# 📦 AceSupply

AceSupply allows you to add highly customizable supply drops to your Minecraft server. It is lightweight, easy to use, and fully configurable.

---

## ✨ Features

* **⏳ Auto-Respawn Timer:** Tweak the precise automatic cooldown interval between spawns.
* **❤️ Supply Drop Health:** Set custom health points for the crates before they can be opened.
* **💎 Custom Loot Tables:** Configure the rewards inside the drops with exact percentage chances.
* **⭐ Supply Rarity:** Create custom supply drop rarities and dynamically configure their specific spawn percentage chances.

---

## 🕹️ How To Use?

* **`/supply menu`** — Opens the plugin menu.
* **`/supply spawn`** — Manually spawn a supply drop instantly.
